name: blockscout
description_en: Blockchain explorer for Ethereum based network and a tool for inspecting and analyzing EVM based blockchains.
readme_excerpt: Blockscout Blockchain Explorer for inspecting and analyzing EVM Chains. Blockscout provides a comprehensive, easy-to-use interface for users to view, confirm, and inspect transactions on EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) blockchains. This includes Ethereum Mainnet, Ethereum Classic, Optimism, Gnosis Chain and many other Ethereum testnets, private networks, L2s and sidechains. See our project documentation for detailed information and setup instructions. For questions, comments and feature requests…
